instagram:
WhatsApp Business catalog. Din bhar ek hi sawaal, bhaiya rate kya hai? Ye 3 chhote kaam kar lijiye. 📲

1. Catalog banaiye: Tools mein Catalog kholiye, har item ki photo, price aur poori detail daaliye. Rate poochhe to bas catalog bhej dijiye.

2. Ready jawab: delivery kab hogi, koi offer hai kya. Jo sawaal sab poochhte hain, unke jawab pehle se likh kar rakhiye. Copy kijiye, bhejiye.

3. Labels: har chat pe label lagaiye. New customer, Payment pending, Order pakka. Shaam ko ek nazar, koi customer chhootega nahi.

Save kar lijiye, aaj raat dukaan band karke catalog banaiye. Comment mein bataiye, aapse WhatsApp pe sabse zyada kaun sa sawaal poochha jata hai? 👇
